messages:
maria: Quick heads up — after last night's internal header rename (X-Route-Policy -> X-Routing-Policy) some customers hit SDK errors in both Python and Go clients. Seeing 400s and streaming disconnects. Any ideas? :thinking:

alex: I noticed spikes in proxy logs around 02:12 UTC. Error snippet from proxy: \"missing required header: X-Routing-Policy\" but some old SDKs still send X-Route-Policy.

joel: Oof. Why did we change the header name for a minor API contract? Was there a backwards-compat plan?

maria: This was to align with console naming (Routing Policy vs Route Policy) and to reduce ambiguity in telemetry. We rolled it via infra script but missed the SDK compatibility matrix. My bad.

sam: For SDKs we should add a graceful shim: accept both headers, prefer new, and emit a metric tag indicating which header was used (legacy|new|both). Then roll a patch to Py/TS/Go with a deprecation warning.

joel: Agreed. Also need a config/env var to force legacy mode for customers that can't upgrade quickly, e.g. RW_ROUTE_HEADER_LEGACY=true. Keep default to auto-detect.

alex: Quick patch idea (pseudo):
```python
# in client header parsing
header = request.headers.get('X-Routing-Policy') or request.headers.get('X-Route-Policy')
meta['route_policy_migration'] = 'new' if 'X-Routing-Policy' in request.headers else 'legacy'
```
Works similarly in TS/Go.

linda: SRE note — if we accept both headers we need to ensure quota attribution and per-route metrics map consistently. Right now quota-ledger keys are computed from header name + value; we must canonicalize before ledger write to avoid double-charging.

maria: Good catch. Proposal: canonicalize to normalized key: `routing_policy:v1:<value>` regardless of which header was present, and emit a migration dimension: `route_policy_migration=legacy|new|both`. That way ledger sees one key and console can show migration progress.

sam: On the console side, we can add a rollout progress tile to the model/route page showing % traffic with `route_policy_migration=new`. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over two days. Telemetry sampling for the console tile should be 100% for migrated customers, but we can sample at 1% for global metrics to save retention.

joel: Also watch streaming: the TS streaming client had header normalization that lowercased keys, which caused the new header to be dropped in one codepath. Patch needs to preserve casing when checking known routing headers (compare lowercased keys vs canonical list).

alex: I can open a quick PR for Python and Go that implements:
- Accept both headers, prefer new
- env var RW_ROUTE_HEADER_LEGACY to force legacy-only
- emit telemetry event `route_header_migration` with value new/legacy/both
- unit tests for streaming and non-streaming flows

maria: Please include a log line when detection falls back to legacy: `RouteHeader=legacy source=sdk-migration` so we can alert on customers stuck on old header.

ci-bot: CI pipeline: preflight tests for client-libs passed for python 3.10/3.11 and go 1.20. 10/10 integration tests green. :white_check_mark:

linda: For quota ledger migration, we'll run a reconciler that maps legacy keys to canonical keys for the last 30 days. Expect some small delta initially. Ops runbook needed if we see >0.5% mismatches.

sam: UX rollout checklist for console tile:
- [ ] Backend metric dimension `route_policy_migration` ingested
- [ ] Ledger canonicalization in place
- [ ] SDK patches released (patch/minor)
- [ ] Canary toggle (5% -> 25% -> 100%) controlled by release flag
- [ ] Announce migration window to customers with opt-out instructions

joel: Timeline? If alex can PR today, we can ship SDK patches tomorrow, start canary after infra deploy. Migration reconciler and console tile might be a 3-day task.

maria: Sounds good. Proposed timeline:
- T+0 (today): PRs for SDKs with shims + env var
- T+1: release SDK patches (py,go,ts) + infra config to accept both headers at edge
- T+2: start 5% canary (monitor `route_policy_migration=new` metric)
- T+3..T+4: 25% -> 100% if metrics stable (errors <0.1%, ledger mismatch <0.5%)

alex: I'll include compatibility tests that spin up a local proxy and assert unified ledger key. Also add e2e that sends both headers in one request to validate `both` tagging.

maria: Who wants to own the console tile? Sam?

sam: I can pick it up after SDK PRs. Will coordinate with analytics for the sampling rate and chart thresholds.

linda: I'll draft the ops runbook and the reconciler job spec. If anyone sees an unexpected spike, ping SRE and add `#incidents` tag.

joel: One more think — mailing list message to customers who use dedicated or private deployments since they may run older SDKs. We should include the env var and rollback instructions.

maria: Agreed. I'll draft the customer notice and post to #customer-success when ready.

ci-bot: Deploy plan created: infra change to accept both headers scheduled in the next deploy window at 04:00 UTC.

sam: Cool. I'll start the console mockup and post screenshots here when done. :shipit:

maria: Thanks all — feel better about this now. Keeping this thread as the migration tracker.
